title: M10 Portfolio Website Project Proposal
text:
AI-Assisted Meta-Analysis for Marketing Decisions

Project title: AI-Assisted Evidence Synthesis for Marketing Decisions
Data/source: Published marketing research studies screened and coded for the MSDM CEP.
Managerial problem: Decision-makers need reliable summaries of dispersed empirical findings.
Target audience: Marketing researchers and decision-makers.
Research objectives: Evaluate AI-assisted coding workflows and synthesize eligible effects.
Expected impact: More transparent evidence-based marketing recommendations.
Methods: Eligibility screening, effect-size extraction, human/AI coding comparison, quantitative meta-analysis as appropriate.

GA4 Website Traffic Analytics

Project title: Portfolio Website Traffic and Engagement Analysis
Data/source: GA4 data to be collected after the site is published.

Research objectives: Which acquisition sources and pages generate engaged visits?
Expected impact: Improve website navigation, content priorities, and outreach.
Methods: GA4 event tracking, descriptive statistics, time trends, channel comparisons, visualization.

title: CEP Dashboard
text:
How can AI-assisted coding and evidence synthesis support more timely and transparent marketing decisions?



Published marketing studies reviewed as part of the MSDM culminating experience project. This page presents the research workflow; no unverified effect-size results are displayed.







1. Study screeningIdentify relevant studies using predefined eligibility criteria.


2. Effect codingExtract reported effect measures and study characteristics.


3. Human vs. AI reviewCompare coding outputs and resolve discrepancies.


4. SynthesisEstimate and interpret pooled effects when eligible data are available.


5. Marketing implicationsTranslate findings into evidence-based recommendations.




This dashboard is a research-process overview. It will be updated with verified project metrics, charts, and results when the final CEP dataset and findings are available.

CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) controls the visual presentation of the site, including colors, typography, spacing, hover states, and responsive layouts. SCSS is a stylesheet language that adds conveniences such as variables and nesting, which are compiled to CSS.

Navigation: subtle border and low-contrast background for clarity.
Hero: responsive two-column layout with an asymmetric portrait frame.
Buttons: color transition and subtle hover lift.
Project cards: responsive grid and interactive category filtering.
Accessibility: descriptive image text, keyboard-accessible buttons, and reduced-motion support.
